## Longcat Distilled API {#longcat-distilled-api}

Longcat Distilled 是 Meituan 推出的文生视频和图生视频模型，在 Venice API 上以 `longcat-distilled-text-to-video` 提供。以私有方式运行，零数据保留。

### Longcat Distilled API 价格 {#longcat-distilled-api-pricing}

| 模型 ID | 变体 | 隐私 | 价格 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `longcat-distilled-text-to-video` | 文生视频 | Private | $0.0177 / 秒 起 |
| `longcat-distilled-image-to-video` | 图生视频 | Private | $0.0177 / 秒 起 |

`longcat-distilled-text-to-video` 的片段价格（无音频）：

| 时长 | 720p |
|---|---|
| 5s | $0.09 |
| 10s | $0.18 |
| 15s | $0.26 |
| 20s | $0.35 |
| 30s | $0.53 |

### 如何使用 Longcat Distilled API {#how-to-use-the-longcat-distilled-api}

使用 `"model": "longcat-distilled-text-to-video"` 和您的 API 密钥向 `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/queue` 发送请求。

```bash
# 1. Queue the job (returns a queue_id)
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/queue \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "longcat-distilled-text-to-video",
    "prompt": "Slow aerial drone shot over a misty mountain valley at golden hour",
    "duration": "5s",
    "resolution": "720p",
    "aspect_ratio": "16:9"
  }'

# 2. Poll until the MP4 is ready
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/retrieve \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "model": "longcat-distilled-text-to-video", "queue_id": "<queue_id>" }' --output video.mp4
```
